quarterly_calculation_date_evidence.quote: "Quarterly Calculation Date" means the last day of each calendar quarter during the term of this Agreement

covenant.quote: Permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio, calculated as of each Quarterly Calculation Date beginning December 31, 2021, to be more than 3.00 to one (3.00:1).

thresholds.quote: Permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio, calculated as of each Quarterly Calculation Date beginning December 31, 2021, to be more than 3.00 to one (3.00:1).

post_fifth_amendment.quote: Permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio, calculated as of each Quarterly Calculation Date beginning December 31, 2021, to be more than 3.00 to one (3.00:1).

evidence.quote: "Consolidated Leverage Ratio" means, with respect to each Quarterly Calculation Date, the ratio of (A) total consolidated Funded Indebtedness of the Corporate Guarantor as at such Quarterly Calculation Date, to (B) Consolidated EBITDA for the 12-month period then ended.

terms.label: Funded Indebtedness
children_labels: obligations evidenced by bonds, debentures, notes, loan agreements or other similar instruments
principal portion of obligations under conditional sale or other title retention agreements
deferred purchase price of property or services
Guarantee Obligations with respect to Indebtedness of types (a) and (b) of any other Person

evidence.quote: "Funded Indebtedness" means Indebtedness of the type described in paragraphs (a), (b), (c), (e), (f) and (i) of the definition of Indebtedness.

evidence_children.quote: (a)all obligations for borrowed money, whether current or long-term;
(b)all obligations of such Person evidenced by bonds, debentures, notes, loan agreements or other similar instruments;
(c)the principal portion of all obligations under conditional sale or other title retention agreements
(e)all obligations in respect of the deferred purchase price of property or services;
(i)all Guarantee Obligations with respect to outstanding Indebtedness of the types specified in clauses (a) and (b) above of any other Person; and

terms.label: Consolidated EBITDA
children_labels: expense for state and federal income taxes paid or accrued

evidence.quote: "Consolidated EBITDA" means, with reference to any period of time, the consolidated net income (or loss) of the Corporate Guarantor for such period, plus, to the extent deducted from revenues in determining consolidated net income, (i) interest expense, (ii) expense for state and federal income taxes paid or accrued, (iii) depreciation, (iv) amortization and (v) extraordinary losses incurred, minus, to the extent included in net income, extraordinary gains realized

draft_notes: Agreement exhibits are EX-99.1 (AAON does not file credit agreements as EX-10).

First, Second, Third and Fourth Amendments were not located as separate exhibits; the Dec 2024 8-K EX-99.1 is a conformed copy reflecting them. When Funded Indebtedness gained clause (i) is not pinned down.

Covenant is tested quarterly on Funded Indebtedness at the Quarterly Calculation Date vs Consolidated EBITDA for the 12-month period then ended (ttm). Consolidated EBITDA has no defined net income term; children are lowercase clause descriptions.
